[[Misela Wahmeh]] is the benevolent middle child of [[Nehbawa Wahmeh]], a well-respected elder of the farming village in Issnur Isles. Her elder brother is [[Mutu Wahmeh|Mutu]] and her younger brother is [[Jedur Wahmeh|Jedur]].

==Dialogue==
:''"My father dedicated his life to helping poor and unfortunate souls here in Istan. I learned from him that a smile from one who has not known happiness is the greatest reward this life has to offer."''

During the quest Misela, the Middle Child:
:''"If we can recover my father's inheritance, I hope to use it to help the poor and hungry across Istan. It is what my father would have wanted. I will see that his legacy lives on!"''

After the quest Misela, the Middle Child:
:''"Ahai, <character name>. It is a pleasure to see you again. You will be happy to know my father's inheritance has been put to good use. Right now we are building a school for children whose parents were slaughtered by corsairs. I only hope I can make some small difference in their lives, like my father did. Thank you for helping make my dreams come true."''
